verdicts.reason: Both score the presence of an explicitly disclosed prior/ongoing agency relationship with identical 10/5/0 anchors and the same exclusion of authority or consequence; Y merely restates the surface-feature caveat at the end.
Both reward a concrete alternative regulatory design specified well enough to implement and give 0 when none is offered, so scores would track each other.
Identical layout criterion — addressee plus citation-tagged itemisation — with the same 10/5/0 anchors and the same rule that contentless items still score 10.
Both require the commenter's own monetary estimate of compliance cost with its basis stated, and both give 0 when no figures appear.
Identical filing-window timing criterion with the same marker list, the same exclusion of in-rule compliance deadlines and other parties' filings, and the same anchors.
Both score whether figures are linked by stated reasoning to an identified provision, with the same worked example and the same 0 for statistics-dense but unlinked comments.
Both score provision-level engagement with the same 10/5/0 anchors and the same rule that a docket or RIN caption is not engagement.
Emotional intensity of register and first-hand operational experience are unrelated properties: a flatly worded practitioner account scores 0 on X and 10 on Y.
Both score the prominence of organisational scale and prestige claims as text with the same marker list, anchors, and prohibition on judging whether scale strengthens the argument.
Both score de novo framing versus incorporation of another filing, with the same markers, the same 10/5/0 anchors, and the same posture-only instruction.
Both count explicit references to prior contact with the agency at the same 10/5/0 anchors and both bar considering whether the relationship adds anything.
Both score assumed expert readership using the same marker list and anchors; Y folds assumed familiarity with the commenter into the cross-reference marker without changing what is measured.
Both score how concretely the comment specifies what would be recorded, measured, or shown to demonstrate compliance; Y only adds an explicit midpoint anchor to the same scale.
Both require reported experience of complying with current requirements tied to a specific effect of the proposal, with the same anchors and the same relationship-is-not-experience rule.
Both are a pure sentence count with the same fewer-than-three threshold and the same instruction to ignore length, content, and quality.
Both score whether substance from earlier dealings is reported and applied to the proposal, with the same anchors and the same 0 for bare references to prior contact.
Both score pooled or patterned observation across the represented population applied to a specific effect of the rule, with the same anchors and the same claimed-breadth-is-not-evidence rule.
A developed statutory-authority argument and the presence of part/section CFR citations are separate properties: either can appear without the other.
Both are a binary presence check for a reference to an attachment, exhibit, appendix, or enclosure, explicitly ignoring the attachment's content.
Both count visible quantified and attributed material without regard to accuracy or use, with the same anchors and the same treatment of numbers that go nowhere versus figure-free reasoning.
Both require a named authority, its requirement, the departure, and a curative text change for 10, with the same 5 and 0 anchors and the same specificity-not-merits instruction.
Both score adversarial legal register from the same phrase list with the same anchors and the same bar on checking whether the characterisation is apt.
Both require hands-on technical or operational particulars tied to the requirement, with the same example specifics, the same generic-to-industry 5, and the same 0 despite precise rule citations.
Both require a named author plus a stated role or regulated relationship for 10, vague standing for 5, and nothing for 0, with letterhead and signature blocks excluded in both.
Both score references to post-publication docket material with the same marker list, the same two-or-more threshold for 10, and the same exclusion of pre-proposal citations.
Both count the same five formal filing conventions with identical 10/5/0 anchors and the same instruction never to score the argument.
Both score only salutation and signature block presence with the same 10/5/0 anchors and the same form-letter-scores-10 example.
Both score mass-campaign register from the same marker list with the same 10/5/0 anchors and the same instruction not to score the position taken.
Both score whether contrary evidence is engaged and reconciled with the comment's own position; Y only adds a midpoint for acknowledged-but-unreconciled evidence on the same scale.
